title: create-objectstack: the starter ships an object but no app, so a newcomer's first Console visit shows nothing of their project
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ③ a task on the maintainer's word. Asked in session on 2026-11-10, after the full-platform test run listed its improvement suggestions, verbatim: 「立卡处理」.

QA-source: #32135 · new-user flow (create-objectstack 18.3.0) · observed beside the clauses
Batch-of: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32135 follow-ups, 15 cards filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」

## What we saw

- `npm create objectstack@latest my-app` (18.3.0) creates `src/objects/note.object.ts` and empty `src/apps`, `src/views`.
- `pnpm dev` → Console Home lists only the platform apps (Setup, Account); the Note object is reachable over REST and MCP but has no route in the Console.
- The scaffold README spends a whole section ("The Console — this starter ships no app") explaining that this is not a broken install.

## Proposed change

Scaffold a minimal app and a default list view for the starter object (the same shapes `os g app --object note` and `os g view note` already write), so the first Console visit shows the project's own data. Keep the README section, shortened to how to add more.

## Business reason

Who: every new user on their first run. Scenario: they create a project, open the Console the banner points to, and see nothing they made. Cost of not doing it: the first impression is "it didn't work", and the fix is buried in prose they have not read yet.

## Reader

Triage first touch; lands in `packages/create-objectstack` (the blank template).

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack scaffold starter no app console` (35 hits, open and closed): #28958, #28954, #21370 touch the starter but not this; no card.
